input:
Earlier scenes:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。他们在很漂亮的河找夹竹桃。神农问他的哥哥：“我应该吃这种植物吗？”哥哥说：“这就要看你想要安全还是接近知道了。“神农一吃夹竹桃就生病了。哥哥说：“太麻烦了。

This scene:
夹竹桃是毒的，我想知道灵芝会帮他。”哥哥给神农灵芝。神农吃完了以后开始痊愈了。神农说：“谢谢哥哥，你帮得真好。灵芝我们可以吃，特别是如果我们已经吃了夹竹桃。“

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 夹竹桃是毒的：有毒的
- 我想知道灵芝会帮他：灵芝有没有用/能不能帮他
- 哥哥给神农灵芝：给了，了completed
- 你帮得真好：你做得很好

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 是毒的：有毒，The adjective-like meaning should be expressed with “有毒”; “是毒的” is not natural here. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 开始痊愈了：开始好转了，“痊愈” means a full recovery, so it does not combine naturally with “开始,” which describes the beginning of a change. “开始好转了” means that his condition began to improve. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 夹竹桃。“：夹竹桃。”，The final quotation mark must be a closing quotation mark. [rule: none]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): “夹竹桃是毒的，我想知道灵芝会帮他。”：哥哥说：“夹竹桃有毒，我想知道灵芝会帮他。”，This new quoted utterance needs a speaker so that “我” has an unambiguous referent; here it can be identified as the brother. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 哥哥给神农灵芝：哥哥给了神农灵芝，This is a completed action in the event sequence, so the verb needs “了.” [rule: aspect_le_completed]
6. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 灵芝我们可以吃，特别是如果我们已经吃了夹竹桃：灵芝可以吃，特别是在我们已经吃了夹竹桃的时候，“特别是” should single out a specific example or circumstance; “如果” introduces a condition, so “特别是在……的时候” links this particular circumstance naturally. [rule: example_marker_tebie_bifang]

items.reason: “毒的” cannot be used predicatively this way; “有毒” is correct.
“痊愈” denotes complete recovery, so “开始好转了” is the appropriate expression for recovery beginning.
The quotation ends with an opening quotation mark instead of the required closing quotation mark.
The new first-person utterance needs a stated speaker so that “我” and “他” can be interpreted clearly.
Giving the ganoderma is a completed story event, so “给了” is required.
“特别是如果……” can validly introduce a condition here, so the student's connector is not itself an error.
